name: Toggle a lens on and off

planSteps.description: Stay on the page that is already open at the start URL and do not navigate to any other address: the chart is on that page. Wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Click the 'About' button in the top bar to open the About panel
In the About panel's lens machine, click the 'Status that stays' lens dial
Verify its reading line changes to 'Misread → Read correctly'
Click the 'Status that stays' lens dial again
Verify its reading line returns to 'Misread'
